hints.title: Explicit Function Context Binding Polyfill
hints.text: Invoking a function with an explicit this binding requires attaching the function to the target context object temporarily.

hints.title: Unique Symbol Property Attachment
hints.text: Generate a unique Symbol to avoid clashing with existing properties on the context. Assign the current function to context[fnSymbol], invoke it with arguments, and remove the property.

hints.title: Call Polyfill Blueprint
hints.text: Declare Function.prototype.callPolyfill = function(context, ...args). Let ctx = Object(context ?? globalThis). const fnKey = Symbol(); ctx[fnKey] = this; const res = ctx[fnKey](...args); delete ctx[fnKey]; return res.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Attaching and invoking via unique symbol key runs in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using string property names like context.__fn__ risks overwriting pre-existing properties on user objects.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Unique Symbol key guarantees collision-free invocation without permanent mutation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly handling primitive contexts like numbers or strings via Object(context).

solutions.approach: Symbol Property Context Invocation and Cleanup
